title: Climate
description: The climate of Tunisia: Mediterranean/arid. Climate dictates the wardrobe, the harvest calendar, the festivals, and the architecture — life bends around weather everywhere. Travelers should check the seasons: the same country can feel like two different places between its wet and dry, hot and cold months.

title: Government
description: Tunisia is governed as a presidential republic. The system of government shapes daily life through laws, services, and the citizen's relationship to the state. Its modern form dates to 1956 (independence) — and like all governments, it continues to evolve with its people.

title: Independence and statehood
description: Statehood in Tunisia: 1956 (independence). National days, flags, and anthems all trace to the moment of independence or founding — the story every schoolchild learns. Understanding it explains the country's pride, its holidays, and often its friendships and rivalries.
